rows.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
rows.claim: Umar reports the Prophet saying that God extracted Adam's descendants, assigning some to Paradise and others to Fire; each is enabled to do the deeds of their destination and dies on that course.
rows.anchor: سمعت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم سئل عنها، فقال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: " إن الله خلق آدم ثم مسح ظهره بيمينه

words: هو القادر على أن يبعث عليكم عذابا من فوقكم
rows.speaker: أبي بن كعب
rows.claim: Ubayy says the four calamities are inevitable; twenty-five years after the Prophet's death, factional division and mutual violence had occurred, while the earth's swallowing and stoning remained.
rows.anchor: عن أبي بن كعب، في قوله تبارك وتعالى: {هو القادر على أن يبعث عليكم عذابا من فوقكم} [الأنعام: 65] الآية، قال: "هن أربع

words: هو القادر على أن يبعث عليكم عذابا من فوقكم
rows.speaker: أبي بن كعب
rows.claim: A parallel Ubayy transmission names pelting (القذف), rather than stoning (الرجم), as the remaining punishment alongside the earth's swallowing.
rows.anchor: عن أبي بن كعب: في قوله {قل هو القادر}

words: وإن عاقبتم فعاقبوا بمثل ما عوقبتم به
rows.speaker: أبي بن كعب
rows.claim: Ubayy reports that after Uhud the Ansar threatened to exceed the Quraysh in retaliation; at Mecca's conquest, after a call against Quraysh, the verse was revealed and the Prophet ordered restraint.
rows.anchor: عن أبي بن كعب، قال: لما كان يوم أحد قتل من الأنصار أربعة وستون رجلا

words: إن يدعون من دونه إلا إناثا
rows.speaker: أبي بن كعب
rows.claim: Ubayy interprets each idol as accompanied by a female jinni.
rows.anchor: عن أبي بن كعب: {إن يدعون من دونه إلا إناثا}

rows.speaker: أبي بن كعب
rows.claim: Ubayy reports that God gathered Adam's descendants as spirits, made them testify to His exclusive lordship, forbade shirk, and promised to send messengers and books to remind them of the covenant.

rows.speaker: الله
rows.claim: Adam saw that the people differed in wealth and appearance and asked why they were not made equal; God answered that He desired gratitude.
